items.text: Hands-on Python developer with 9 years' commercial Python delivery in Front Office trading environments. Built server-side Python services and REST APIs for a gas and power trading desk, and a real-time P&L service for a fixed income desk. Currently delivering cloud-native services on AWS (ECS, Lambda, S3) with Terraform and CI/CD in Agile teams. Right to work in the UK.
